# voltras-mcp

> A stdio MCP server that lets Claude drive a Voltra cable-resistance trainer: connect, set the load, record sets and reps, and report on the history. One server process per Claude Code session. Not published to npm; install from source. Training records stay in a local SQLite file, and the dashboard binds 127.0.0.1 only.

## The dashboard

- [The wall dashboard](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard): what the local dashboard shows, its five screens and which are available
- [Set it up and open it](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-setup): build it, launch the server so it is on, find its address, and fix it when it does not open
- [Live workout tour](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-tour): captures of each stage of the live page, from before a device connects to the session summary
- [Read the fatigue card](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-fatigue): the fatigue card from a fresh set through past the 20% line, and the verdict on the session summary
- [Read pacing and form](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-pacing-and-form): the tempo target, the range-of-motion light, the rest stage and the two-device readout
- [Review a session on the dashboard](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-session-review): the verdict, the set it came from, and the load recommendation for next time
- [Build a plan on the dashboard](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/dashboard-plan-builder): browse the catalog and build, retarget, reorder or delete a workout by hand

## Get started

- [Get started](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/start/): what you need, and the order to read the setup pages in
- [Install](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/start/install): clone, build and register the server with Claude Code
- [Your first session](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/start/first-session): connect, record a set and close the session
- [Try it without a device](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/start/try-without-a-device): the mock adapter and the scripted dashboard drivers
- [Launch options](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/start/launch-options): the voltra-pt plugin launcher versus plain registration

## Reference

- [Capability reference](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/reference/): every tool, resource and push event, generated from the tool registry
- [Push events](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/reference/push-events): the events the server pushes into the conversation
- [Dashboard API](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/reference/dashboard-api): the dashboard's HTTP routes and response shapes, for developers
- [Page status](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/status): what Available, Experimental and Coming soon promise

## Guides and concepts

- [Guides](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/guides/): task guides for sessions, bilateral work, isometric tests and reports
- [Understand your data](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/concepts/): what the numbers from a session mean
- [Velocity and effort](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/concepts/velocity-and-effort): velocity loss, reps in reserve, and when the server states an effort number
- [Calibration and trust](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/concepts/calibration-and-trust): which numbers are measured and which are derived

## For coaches

- [For coaches](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/coaches/): session and weekly reports, and the TrueCoach import
- [Consent and the data loop](https://hjewkes.github.io/voltras-mcp/coaches/consent-and-data-loop): what is shared with a coach, and when
